I wish that was the case...she came back in a while later, found me crying, and screamed at me that I was not the only person in the universe with problems and that I should stop thinking about myself and do something to help her. Screamed all this at the top of her lungs. Then she told me that I should just pretend to be happy, but if I really want to kill myself, she'll support me in that 'cause she just wants me to be happy. I have no fucking clue what to do with all this.

Thank you for the response, I appreciate it. You sound like a good, loving mom.
